item.title: Ask George: What’s the difference between shrimp and prawns?
item.description: Although shrimp and prawns look and taste similar, they are actually different animals. Both are decapods (crustaceans with 10 legs), but they belong to separate suborders, which means they’re distinct creatures. To confuse matters, the names vary by country. In the U.
